elements.description: A database-style table that works like a small spreadsheet.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The table's name: its heading and the grid's label

properties.name: icon
properties.description: An icon element in front of the heading (cloned)

properties.name: columns
properties.description: The columns, left to right: each one's key, label, type, width and whether it can be edited

properties.name: rows
properties.description: The rows. Edits change them unless a tc-rows-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: sort
properties.description: Sort; null shows the rows in their own order

properties.name: tagTones
properties.description: Tag colors by tag text – falls back to blue

properties.name: readonly
properties.description: Read only: selection and copy still work

properties.name: renderCell
properties.type: ((row: DataRow, column: DataColumn) => Node | string | undefined) | undefined
properties.description: Draw a cell yourself: return a Node or a string, or undefined for the default

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-rows-change
events.description: Rows were edited, pasted, cleared, added, deleted, undone or redone ({ rows }); cancelable

events.name: tc-selection-change
events.description: Rows were checked or unchecked ({ selection }); cancelable

props.name: renderCell
props.type: (row: DataRow, column: DataColumn) => Node | string | undefined
props.description: Draws a cell itself: a DOM node or a string; undefined leaves the cell to the table. Gets the row as the app gave it

props.name: title
props.description: The table's heading and the grid's name

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon in front of the title

props.name: columns
props.description: The columns, left to right: each one's key, label, type, width and whether it can be edited

props.name: defaultRows
props.description: The rows to start with when `rows` isn't controlled

props.name: onRowsChange
props.description: Called with every row after an edit, paste, clear, add, delete, undo or redo

props.name: selection
props.description: Ids of the checked rows (controlled) – pair it with `onSelectionChange`

props.name: defaultSelection
props.description: The checked rows to start with when `selection` isn't controlled

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the ids of the checked rows whenever a row is checked or unchecked

props.name: sort
props.description: The sorted column and direction, or null for the rows' own order (controlled)

props.name: defaultSort
props.description: The sort to start with when `sort` isn't controlled

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called when a column header changes the sort

props.name: editable
props.description: false turns the table read only

changelog: data-table and agent-lanes: a look selector left in front of a comment turned two rules into descendant selectors, so Clean lost data-table's coloured tag pills and agent-lanes' Reject / Approve button styles.

Lit 3 web components: `tc-button`, `tc-combobox` and `tc-data-table` (the pilot), `tc-look-provider` for an app-wide default look, the shared controllers (row window, focus rescue, smooth height, off-screen, on-screen, ARIA forwarding, hotkeys, rolling numbers). Pixel-identical to the React components in both looks and themes.
data-table renders only the rows in view above 60 rows (was 200); combobox windows options above 300 matches; command-menu shows at most `maxRows` (default 200) results.
data-table renders only the rows in view above 200 rows (spacer rows keep the scroll height; `aria-rowcount` and `aria-rowindex` are set on every row).
